correlationId.description: Opaque nonblank client-generated string, echoed exactly. UUIDs are recommended, not validated, matching socket runtime behavior.

containerId.description: Exactly characterId when present; otherwise player-<trimmed lowercase playerName>. Additional identity properties are preserved.

characterId.description: Owned character scope. If absent, aggregate all characters owned by this player.

startAt.description: Inclusive lower bound on entry.timestamp, compared as instants. Affects total, not balance. Must not be after endAt.

endAt.description: Inclusive upper bound on entry.timestamp. Affects total, not balance.

limit.description: Maximum effective limit is 200; larger positive safe integers are clamped to 200. Nonintegers, nonpositive values and unsafe integers fail with invalid-request.
